description:
Easy Street Capital is a private real estate lender serving real estate investors around the country. Defined by an experienced team and innovative loan programs, Easy Street Capital is the ideal financing partner for real estate investors of all experience levels and specialties. Whether an investor is fixing and flipping, financing a cash-flowing rental, or building ground-up, we have a solution to fit those needs.
 
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Full Stack Developer to join our growing team, building innovative solutions in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex problems and contributing to a modern tech stack. You’ll be surrounded by a dedicated, supportive team building cutting edge technology that will empower our teams, drive customer experience and level up the organization.

Responsibilities 

 Independently deliver complex  React.Js + TypeScript  front end features and  MongoDB –backed services.

 Integrate with  RESTful APIs  and influence API design for reliability, security, and performance using Node.js with Express.js Framework.

 Write behavior driven automation, unit tests and contribute to testing strategy.

 Work with AWS Services - Lambda, S3, SES, CloudWatch.

 Mentor and support junior engineers, contribute to documentation, and design system components.

 Contribute to ensuring compliance standards are met (e.g., SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR)


Required Skills 

 Strong experience building production web applications with  React  (or similar) and  TypeScript .

 Strong experience with  RESTful API  development.

 Strong understanding of  MongoDB  back-end development.

 Serverless Architecture- Experience connecting systems with AWS Lamda services.

 Solid testing skills across unit, integration, and E2E; CI/CD familiarity.

 Security awareness (OWASP, CSP, input validation).

 Bachelors in CS/Engineering or equivalent experience


Desired Skills 

 GraphQL experience and API caching strategies.

 Experience with Python AI programming or machine learning.

 Experience developing mobile applications.


Benefits 

 Company sponsored health insurance

 Company sponsored 401(k)

 Paid vacation time

 Paid sick leave


We are looking for the right team member to join our team. If you feel you are that person, please apply!
